verdict.rationale: The privacy-posture axis applies, since a Git hosting service, including Gitea's managed offering, could plausibly document an AI-training opt-out or no-training policy. Nothing in the evidence addresses AI model training. Self-hosting and 'full control' claims are adjacent deployment properties, not a documented training opt-out or data-use commitment, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
